additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
Today I tried to access the PLC but is not possible. The Application Board (Linux part) of the open controller is working and, that's why we see the charger online on SCB but the PLC is not responding.
I
brought
the case to R&D but no solution is possible. Please replace the PLC KF1.
